artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan replacing invocation-path-dependent fixed-depth repo-root computations in five core test suites with the existing common_test_repo_root/common_test_ext_root helpers, plus a deployed-mode EXT_ROOT fix in orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh and a measure-first adjacent-class sweep.

memory_candidates.content: A shell test suite that computes its own repository root by walking up a hardcoded number of path segments is invocation-path dependent whenever the same file is executed from two tree depths (a source store at agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/tests, five levels down, and its deployed copy at .claude/scripts/tests, three levels down). The failure is quiet, not loud: the over-walk resolves to a path outside the repository, and downstream repo-relative helpers return their own fail-open sentinels (CANNOT_COMPUTE and similar) rather than erroring, so the suite reports a NEW failure whose stated cause is unrelated to the real one. Diagnostic: echo the computed root under both paths and run the suite from both; a source-store pass plus a deployed-path failure indicts the walk-up depth, not the logic under test. The same class also hides SUT-side: a production script globbing "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.."/*/agents/x.md resolves to the repo root from a deployed location, where * cannot match the leading dot of .claude, so the lookup silently yields empty in production too. Remedy: a git-rev-parse-first resolver with a fixed-depth fallback, as one shared helper, never a per-suite bespoke walk.
